purpose: Teach: 完売/手形/再販/増収/不問/別個/特産/海苔

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、新商品を完売しろ
lines.en: Sell out the new product line.
lines.style: Clipped authority. Decisive opening. No room for question. Command voice, not raised—just clear. Eyes steady on the recipient.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先の手形決済が確認されました
lines.en: Yes. We've confirmed the settlement with our partner on the bill of exchange.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment with quiet competence. Professional pace. Direct eye contact maintained throughout. Slight nod at the confirmation—assurance without overstepping.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 絶版商品の再販を検討しろ
lines.en: Look into re-releasing the out-of-print products.
lines.style: Measured directive. Weight behind each word. Slight forward lean—this matters. The tone of someone who knows what the market needs.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。今期は増収増益の見込みです
lines.en: Yes. We're forecasting increased revenue and profit for this fiscal year.
lines.style: Clear, steady update delivered without embellishment. Slight lift at the end—the numbers speak. Confident but not celebrating prematurely.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 過去の経歴は不問とし採用しろ
lines.en: Hire without regard to past employment history.
lines.style: Direct principle stated as fact. No hesitation. Authoritative but not harsh—this is how it will be. Brief, final, moving forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新事業を別個の法人で運営します
lines.en: Yes. We'll operate the new division as a separate corporation.
lines.style: Formal affirmation. Measured pace. The structure is sound—delivered with controlled precision. Acknowledging the scope of the decision.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 地域特産品を商品ラインに加えろ
lines.en: Add local specialty products to our product line.
lines.style: Strategic instruction. Calm authority. Eyes engaged—this is about market expansion. Weight on the key directive without rushing.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。海苔メーカーとの提携を進めております
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward with a partnership with a nori manufacturer.
lines.style: Closing status report. Measured and clear. Slight sense of momentum—progress is underway. Professional finality, slightly warmer than the previous updates.
